title: docs: delete eight obsolete planning docs and point the root docs at the live pages
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9HiJAYedonvaHNCDwdoW14J)_
Fixes #26075
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

This is PR 2 of 2 under ruling A (6417413905). PR 1 (#26246, merged) moved the spec-major fingerprint out of `docs/v17-docs-sweep.md`. This PR deletes the obsolete planning docs and makes the root docs say only what is true today. History stays in git: every deleted file can still be read at commit `df8aac41`.

## Deleted

`docs/NEXT_STEP.md`, `docs/DX_ROADMAP.md`, `docs/PLUGIN_ECOSYSTEM_MAP.md`, `docs/upgrading-to-11.md`, `docs/v17-docs-sweep.md`, `docs/launch-readiness.md`, `docs/plans/m1-project-artifact-schema.md`, `docs/plans/release-15.1-test-plan.md`.

## Root docs

- **`ARCHITECTURE.md`** is now a single paragraph that points to the published architecture page (`content/docs/concepts/architecture.mdx`, https://objectstack.ai/docs/concepts/architecture). It also links the old long-form text at `df8aac41`. Inbound links from `README.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `RELEASE_NOTES.md`, ADR-0001 and `docs/design/driver-turso.md` still resolve, so none of those files are touched.
- **Root `CHANGELOG.md`** keeps its history. A new top line points to `content/docs/releases/` and says the file is no longer extended. Its three links to `docs/upgrading-to-11.md` now point to that file at `df8aac41`.
- **`RELEASE_NOTES.md`** is frozen. Its top banner now says "historical and frozen". The never-shipped `_(in progress)_` marker is removed from the v4.0.4 heading. The pointer to `.changeset/v5-project-to-environment-rename.md` is dropped (that file never existed); ADR-0006 stays as the rationale. `ARCHITECTURE.md` carried the same dangling pointer and lost it in the rewrite.
- **`docs/audits/README.md`** gains the lifecycle rule: an audit is open, then closed, then moved to `docs/audits/archive/`.

## Inbound references fixed

- **Published page:** `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx:580` no longer sends readers to a repository path. The sentence keeps its fact: the aliases were removed from `client-react` in v11.
- **Docs:** `docs/qa/platform-checklist/README.md` (the predecessor link now goes to the file at `df8aac41`; the table row says that the items' `§…` source citations resolve at that commit), `docs/PLATFORM_GAPS_FROM_TEMPLATES.md`, and `packages/metadata/ROADMAP.md` (not in that package's `files`).
- **Source comments that used a deleted file as a live pointer now name the commit that holds it:**
  - `service-automation` `engine.ts` and `plugin.ts`
  - `service-realtime` `in-memory-realtime-adapter.ts` and `realtime-service-plugin.ts`
  - `scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`
  - `scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs`
  - `scripts/check-doc-authoring.mjs`: its example guide name changes, and the stale "twelve" count is dropped.
  - `packages/spec/scripts/build-docs.ts`: the dead `DX_ROADMAP.md` pointer is dropped. This is a script, not in the spec package's `files`.
- **`scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs` gate input:** `docs/launch-readiness.md` was one of its `INSTRUCTION_SURFACES` (scan-only, `mustName: []`). The gate hard-fails on a surface it cannot read, so the row is removed along with the file. Measured: without this change the gate reports `docs/launch-readiness.md could not be read: the file does not exist`.

## Deliberately left as history (not edited)

- `docs/adr/0087-metadata-protocol-upgrade-contract.md:65` names `docs/upgrading-to-11.md` in a code span. ADRs are a governed surface.
- Ten package `CHANGELOG.md` files carry one mention each: `cli`, `core`, `driver-mongodb`, `driver-sql`, `plugin-auth`, `plugin-security`, `service-automation`, `service-job`, `service-messaging`, `spec`. They are release-owned.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json`: 20 item `source` citations of `release-15.1-test-plan.md §…` across six area files. They are provenance records. The README row above now tells the reader where they resolve.
- `packages/services/service-realtime/README.md:27` says "launch-readiness P0-5". It is a label, not a path, and the README ships in that package's tarball. It is left alone so that this PR publishes nothing.

## Not in this PR: archiving the 2026-06 audit series (#26257)

The ruling also asked to archive the closed 2026-06 series. Measurement showed that moving it is not docs-only, so the owning seat chose to add only the lifecycle line here and filed the move as #26257. Of the 24 `docs/audits/2026-06-*.md` files:

- **6 are cited by path from ADRs**, which are governed: ADR-0049, ADR-0061, ADR-0078, ADR-0082 (two files) and ADR-0112. The files are `security-identity-property-liveness`, `record-search-liveness`, `metadata-functional-completeness`, `react-blocks-conformance`, `react-tier-authoring-dogfood` and `handwritten-docs-accuracy-followups`.
- **14 are cited from the published `@objectstack/spec` package.** The citations are in `liveness/*.json` `_note` fields and in three `src/**/*.zod.ts` comments: `field.zod.ts`, `app.zod.ts`, and `validation.zod.ts`, whose TSDoc also generates `content/docs/references/data/validation.mdx`. The 14 files are `action`, `agent`, `app`, `dashboard`, `field`, `flow`, `hook`, `object`, `report`, `skill`, `tool`, `view`, `validation` and `dead-surface-disposition-plan`. Moving them needs a spec patch changeset and regenerated references.
- **4 have no inbound reference outside `docs/audits/`:** `ask-build-agent-development-assessment`, `datasetschema`, `pageschema` and `system-integration`.

## Evidence (head `0630f8b1`, base `3d50a43b`)

- Running `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on this head derives **113 families**. All 113 ran locally and exited 0, with each exit code captured before any pipe. Reconciling with `--ran` gives `113 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. The list includes the families this card names: `check:doc-authoring`, `check:required-contexts`, `check:doc-anchors`, `check:published-readme-links` and `check:pm-dispatch-gates`. Four families first stopped at their prerequisite (exit 3): `check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n` needed built `dist/` trees, and the `check-plugin-teardown-shape` self-test needed its pinned fixture commit fetched. All four went green once the prerequisite was supplied.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-realtime typecheck` both exit 0. Those packages only have comment edits.
- `git grep` over the whole repo for every deleted path: the only hits left are commit-anchored references, plus the history listed above.
- **lychee: NOT MEASURED locally.** The pinned binary could not be fetched in this container, so the advisory `Check Links` lane on this PR is the reading. Its globs are `content/**`, `README.md` and `ARCHITECTURE.md`, and none of them still links to a deleted file. The two relative targets this PR adds (`content/docs/concepts/architecture.mdx` and `content/docs/releases`) both exist.

## Acceptance notes

- This PR changes docs, in-repo scripts and source comments only. It publishes nothing, so it carries `skip-changeset`. The four package files edited are comment-only `src/*.ts`. `packages/metadata/ROADMAP.md` and `packages/spec/scripts/build-docs.ts` are outside their packages' `files`.
- The branch was reset onto `main` after #26246 landed. The remote head had been deleted on merge, so this was a plain push and no force-push was needed.
